evidence.label: Account signup collects email, name, optional phone
evidence.detail: SignupRequest in APIClient.swift sends username, email, password, displayName, phone to the Sticks API.

evidence.label: Precise location sent to server
evidence.detail: postTee sends lat/lng/accuracy per tee shot; nearbyCourses queries with lat/lng. GPS via CoreLocation (LocationService).

evidence.label: User content: scores, matches, side-game picks
evidence.detail: Scores and match data posted to the API and shared with group members.

evidence.label: No analytics, ads, or tracking SDKs
evidence.detail: No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs present; networking is first-party API plus Esri map tiles.
